name: Glitch neon reveal
what: A line of neon text flashes in as a squashed band, its letters shuffle into other letters for about half a second and then read right, the text keeps growing while a bright glint sweeps across it from right to left, and at the end one letter lights up.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1 the text flashes in as a squashed, dim band; f2-f19 every letter is swapped for another one each frame (more of them right as it goes; every letter one step on in the alphabet on f18-f19, a few lit lighter f9-f17); f20 it reads right; f20-f44 it grows slowly, f44-f66 faster, to full size fixed on its baseline; f48-f57 a white glint with a bloom sweeps across it from right to left; f112-f119 one letter lights up

tracks.name: flash
tracks.what: the text flashes in squashed and dim

tracks.name: shuffle
tracks.what: every letter changes each frame until the text reads right on f20

tracks.name: grow
tracks.what: the text grows from 72 % to its full size, slowly then faster

tracks.name: glint
tracks.what: a white glint with a bloom sweeps across the text from right to left
